findings.replacement: 此资源没有记录来源对话。
findings.why: The zh mobile catalogue keeps two words apart: 对话 = conversation (home.tip.search «搜索过往对话以重新打开会话», session.conversation_details «对话详情», schedules.*, notifications.*) and 会话 = session (projects.sessions.count «# 个会话», session_health.*). English "source conversation" is a conversation → 对话. On the same screen the button beside it is «打开对话» (action.open_chat) and the «出现于» list it sits under lists conversation titles, so 会话 contradicts the sibling control and reads as a different object (a session). Core zh desktop library (tui.library.*) uses 会话 for this, but the mobile catalogue is the binding reference for a mobile screen.
findings.verified: mobile zh grep for 对话/会话 usage; before/after render in audit.log
